general.title: Amazon Launches Satellites for Network to Rival Starlink
general.summary: A European rocket blasted off Tuesday carrying 36 satellites for Amazon.com Inc.’s orbital communications network that the technology giant hopes will rival Elon Musk’s Starlink.

general.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Costs More This Year With Grocery Prices Rising
general.summary: Economists say a jump in October food costs was only the beginning.

general.title: Asian tech stocks recover from ‘collateral damage’ of Jensen Huang’s departure
general.summary: Investors piled back into the tech market, following the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang by its board.

general.title: Xiaomi’s Sales Fall After Memory Crunch Hits Smartphones
general.summary: Xiaomi Corp. reported a revenue contraction for the third quarter in a row while it grapples with a global memory crunch that’s hobbled the world’s biggest smartphone makers.

general.title: Wealth Taxes Have Become an Election Rallying Cry in Europe
general.summary: Fighting for re-election, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez joined governments around Europe reaching for the lowest-hanging political fruit: He proposed increasing taxes on the super-rich.
